{{Quote|It's called bilerat stew, Zayne—it's one of the few staples we've got plenty of. Smells awful, but the thermochurns keep it good for months.|[[Koblus Sornell|Ko Sornell]] to [[Zayne Carrick]]|<ref name="War2" />}}
'''Bile-rat stew''', or '''bilerat stew''', was a [[Stew/Legends|stew]] prepared by the [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusader]] [[Army/Legends|army]] that [[Battle of Halthor|conquered]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Halthor]]. A thick, green-[[Color/Legends|colored]] dish, bile-rat stew had a scent that was considered foul by most, but was easily portable and could remain preserved in [[thermochurn]]s for [[Standard month/Legends|months]] at a [[Time/Legends|time]], making it an ideal food for the nomadic [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]].<ref name="War2" />

Following the battle on Halthor, the [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] Mandalorians of [[Clan Sornell]] prepared a meal of bile-rat stew at their [[Clan Sornell's house|temporary home]] on the planet's surface. There, they dined with the captured [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]-turned-Mandalorian conscript [[Zayne Carrick]] and former [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Republic Navy/Legends|naval]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]], [[Dallan Morvis]].<ref name="War2" /> Bile-rat stew became an integral part of Carrick's plans to derail a Mandalorian attack on the [[Jedi Enclave]] at [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]], when the young Jedi used the stew to create the illusion of an outbreak of the non-existent disease, "Jedi brain fever."<ref name="War3">[[Knights of the Old Republic: War 3|''Knights of the Old Republic: War'' 3]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Bile-rat stew first appeared in ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in the [[Knights of the Old Republic: War 2|second issue]] of [[John Jackson Miller]]'s five-part miniseries, ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic: War]]''. It continued to appear in the series' [[Knights of the Old Republic: War 3|third]] and [[Knights of the Old Republic: War 4|fourth]] issues.
